main.description: Whether this AppView indexes a blob as part of a Bluemoji: referenced by an emoji or sticker item's formats, or as a pack's icon, in the given repo, and not belonging to a taken-down account. Public. Lets an image proxy serve only Bluemoji assets instead of acting as a general blob CDN. 'available: false' is a definitive no for this AppView (it may simply not have indexed a very new record yet).

did.description: The repo that holds the blob.
